title: YOELEO SAT C45 DB Pro NxT Gravel wheelset
notes: Official YOELEO store page: hooked rim, 45 mm front and rear depth, 27 mm inner and 34.3 mm outer width, tubeless-ready rim bed without spoke holes, YOELEO NxT hub with 36T ratchet, 12x100/12x142 mm thru-axle, Shimano HG 11/12, Campagnolo N3W or SRAM XDR freehubs, Black Aero 2.0 spokes on 24H/24H rims, 1,380 g ±5%, 125 kg system weight limit, suggested tires 35-53 mm and a 3-year warranty. US$999 in the store's USD currency. No rotor mount, maximum tire pressure or mainland China price is published.
